hook: Starlink signals with precise orbit data gave 2.33 m horizontal accuracy (95%) in a field test
summary: The team extracted time-of-arrival measurements from live Starlink Ku-band downlinks and paired them with high-fidelity orbit and clock models, as if the operator supplied them. In a field campaign the 95% error bounds were 2.33 m horizontal, 3.37 m vertical and 11.19 ns in timing. The orbit and clock data were produced by the researchers, not provided by Starlink, so this is a mock of a possible future system.
title: Toward Pseudorange-Based PNT with Starlink: A Mock Fused LEO GNSS Implementation
